data.title: Minister of State for Foreign Affairs Discusses Regional, International Developments with British MPs
data.content:
London, November 19, 2026, SPA -- Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, Cabinet Member, Climate Envoy, and Commissioner General of Riyadh Expo 2030 Adel Al-Jubeir met today in London with several members of the British Parliament, led by MP Kit Malthouse, during his official visit to the United Kingdom.
    During the meeting, the two sides discussed the latest regional and international developments and reviewed the historical relations between Saudi Arabia and the United Kingdom.
    Saudi Ambassador to the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland Prince Abdullah bin Khalid bin Sultan bin Abdulaziz attended the meeting.
    -- SPA
